prompt: I just staged a bunch of docs changes — updated the README, added API docs for the callout plugin, and fixed some typos in the contributing guide. What should my commit message look like? Please generate one using our project convention.
assertions: Type is a valid Conventional Commits type
Subject contains '#<N>' issue reference after the colon
Subject does not end with a period
All body lines are under 200 characters
Subject has a non-empty description after the issue reference
